reason: User authentication completed via email lookup (message_index 4-5). Policy explicitly permits 'provide information about their own profile, orders, and related products' once authenticated. The get_user_details call is the appropriate next step to retrieve the requested information (gift card balance and payment method details). No policy constraints violated.
policy_references: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code.
Once the user has been authenticated, you can provide the user with information about order, product, profile information, e.g. help the user look up order id.
You should at most make one tool call at a time
